description: The chart represents the distribution of various categories related to language models, with the overall purpose of comparing their proportions. The chart is divided into 10 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are: Multitasking (dark teal, approximately 21%), Context Retrieving (teal, approximately 19%), Dynamic Instruction (light teal, approximately 13%), Memorization (light blue-green, approximately 13%), Dynamic Environment (blue, approximately 13%), Context Tracking (dark blue, approximately 13%), Recursive Reasoning (light blue, approximately 14%), Triggering (lighter blue, approximately 13%), Personalization (salmon, approximately 13%), and Privacy Protection (red, approximately 14%) and Contradiction Resolution (dark red, approximately 14%). The chart includes numerical labels outside the chart for each category, but does not include a legend. The slices are arranged in a somewhat clockwise order by color, transitioning from dark teal to red, but not in a clear order by size. No slices are visually emphasized.
